section.codeblock:
Configure a site-to-site VPN connection on a Windows 10 machine.

Before you begin, ensure the following prerequisites are met:

  • Administrator privileges on the Windows 10 machine.
  • IP addresses and shared secret from the VPN gateway administrator.
  • Firewall ports 500 and 4500 are open between the client and gateway.

This task applies to Windows 10 (version 1903 and later).

Open Settings Network & Internet VPN .

Settings path: Settings Network & Internet VPN .

The VPN connection appears in the VPN list and you can connect to the site network.
section.p: Result: Place environment, permission, and system prerequisites in the <prereq> element so processors and output formats can surface them before the procedure.
